The '''Aquellans''' were a cultural group of [[Human/Legends|Human]] originating on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Aquella]]. They were known to speak a [[Aquellan language|guttural-sounding]] [[Language/Legends|language]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
